$description:
Action contract — momentary controls that perform an action now.

Covers Button, IconButton, SplitButton, and ButtonGroup. Action controls share
the physical CONTROL substrate (height, padding, focus ring, press feedback),
but get their own namespace so momentary "pressed" styling never has to stand
in for persistent selected/on styling (Toggle/Segment).

Axis-dependent colour hooks are intentionally not declared at :root. Recipes
should consume them at the use-site with live semantic fallbacks, e.g.
  --a63-action-control-background -> var(--a63-action-neutral)
  --a63-action-control-foreground -> var(--a63-action-neutral-foreground)
  --a63-action-primary-background -> var(--a63-action-primary)
  --a63-action-danger-background  -> var(--a63-action-danger)
